text:
```yaml
name: PX4 Metadata Sync

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 6 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  update-metadata:
    if: github.repository_owner == 'mavlink'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Download PX4 metadata
        run: |
          mkdir -p src/AutoPilotPlugins/PX4
          mkdir -p src/FirmwarePlugin/PX4
          curl -L -o src/AutoPilotPlugins/PX4/AirframeFactMetaData.xml https://artifacts.px4.io/Firmware/_general/airframes.xml
          curl -L -o src/FirmwarePlugin/PX4/PX4ParameterFactMetaData.xml https://artifacts.px4.io/Firmware/_general/parameters.xml

      - name: Create Pull Request
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v8
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: 'chore: update PX4 metadata'
          title: 'chore: update PX4 metadata'
          body: |
            Automated update of PX4 metadata from artifacts.px4.io.
          branch: px4-metadata-update
          delete-branch: true
          add-paths: |
            src/AutoPilotPlugins/PX4/AirframeFactMetaData.xml
            src/FirmwarePlugin/PX4/PX4ParameterFactMetaData.xml
```
